Hymn 120: Lean on My Ample Arm
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Theodore E. Curtis
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 120 titled "Lean on My Ample Arm" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Theodore E. Curtis.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
